  PROBLEM: The retry polling loop uses bare `gh api` without retry or rate-limit handling.
  WHY: A transient API failure can make `CANDIDATES` empty and lead to a false `retry_timeout`; one reviewer called the range 1590-1603, but the root cause is the same.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1568-1641 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: PR head checks fail open on API error.
  WHY: `gh api ... || echo ""` makes an API failure indistinguishable from an empty result, so the script can report success without confirming the editor pushed a fix commit.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1618-1620 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `tail -n 1` picks the oldest retry candidate instead of the latest.
  WHY: The API response is newest-first, so selecting the last line can inspect the wrong run when multiple candidates exist.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1527-1530 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Pytest installation failure is silently swallowed, so missing pytest is misdiagnosed as a test/spec failure.
  WHY: The pip/apt fallback uses `|| true`, leaving `run_pytest()` to fail later with `ModuleNotFoundError` rather than a clear infrastructure error.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1506-1513 | severity=low | confidence=4

  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: PR head fetch can silently pass when the API call fails.
  WHY: An empty `PR_HEAD` does not equal `BAIT_SHA`, so the no-editor-commit check can be bypassed on transient API failure.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1482-1508 | severity=low | confidence=4

  WHY: Without it, step failure can short-circuit the job and prevent later phases from running.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1586-1591 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The retry dispatch assumes `internal-review.yml` exists in the consumer repo.
  WHY: If that workflow is missing, `gh workflow run` fails with workflow-not-found and the retry path dead-ends.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1574-1577 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The PR head fetch in the success branch can bypass no-editor-commit checking.
  WHY: `gh api ... || echo ""` can let an API failure appear as a non-match and falsely pass commit verification.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:37-38 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The canary fixture skips silently when required env vars are missing.
  WHY: Misconfigured Phase 4b setup can therefore skip verification instead of failing loudly.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:24 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The expected canary content is duplicated across multiple sources.
  WHY: Drift between the workflow-issued spec and the test’s hardcoded expectation can cause false byte-for-byte failures.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:165-167 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The bait comment is stale relative to the current multi-line corruption flow.
  WHY: It is documentation-only and does not affect runtime behavior.
